# Era Life Community — v0.1.4 Alpha 1

Version **v0.1.4-alpha.1** is an early desktop prerelease of the reconstructed
community project. Back up existing saves before playing.

## What changed since v0.1.3-alpha.1

- Checkpoint restoration now preserves vehicles, belongings, properties, heirlooms,
  pets, relationship graph data, and the entity registry.
- Vehicle and other asset ownership IDs retain their numeric type through encoded
  save files, so restored assets remain attached to the correct character.
- Loading another checkpoint wakes and services the restore scheduler without being
  starved by the currently attached life.
- Failed or completed restore records no longer leave the service pump continuously
  armed.
- Added an encoded asset round-trip regression test covering both hydration paths.

## Downloads

Download the archive for your system and extract it fully. Godot is not required.
On Linux and Windows, keep the executable and `EraLife.pck` together. On macOS,
open the included app bundle. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the archive checksums.

| Platform | File | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linux x86_64 | `EraLife-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Archive verified; freshly extracted build passed a 300-frame headless startup check |
| Windows x86_64 | `EraLife-windows-x86_64.zip` | Archive verified; native Windows playtest pending; unsigned |
| macOS Intel / Apple Silicon | `EraLife-macos-universal.zip` | Universal x86_64/arm64 bundle verified; native Mac playtest pending |

The macOS app has an ad-hoc testing signature, **not** a Developer ID signature or
Apple notarization. Downloaded builds may be blocked by Gatekeeper. Do not disable
system-wide security protections to run a test build. Windows may also display an
unsigned-app warning. Android APKs are not included in this desktop release.

## Validation and known limits

The focused suite passed actor restoration, restore scheduling, checkpoint progress,
market access during restore, encoded asset round trips, mode checkpointing, release
channel behavior, and all 22 Narrative routes. Existing shutdown resource-cleanup
warnings remain. Windows and macOS still require native gameplay testing, and this
alpha is not a complete birth-to-death validation.

See the [desktop validation notes](https://github.com/miikaTheCoder/Era-Life-Community/blob/v0.1.4-alpha.1/docs/DESKTOP-GAMEPLAY.md)
for broader coverage and remaining limitations.
